digest.component_or_area: link creation and dependency graph composition
propositions: Cross-subtree blocking links are silently escalated to nearest common ancestor children with no indication to library or MCP callers that a different edge was recorded.
The redirect record describing the escalation is printed to stdout only, which is discarded by quiet=True context managers in the call chain, making it invisible to all non-CLI callers.

Five layers in the propagation chain (add_dependency, link_core, _link closure, _python_leaf, rebar.link) must each explicitly return the redirect record; three were silently dropping it on the floor.

_python_leaf must be widened to return its inner call's value instead of None, affecting all Tier B leaf writes (comment, tag, edit, archive), though existing callers ignore the return and thus see no behavior change.

MCP link_tickets tool and library rebar.link() must communicate when escalation occurred, with link_tickets returning a structured string template: ok (escalated: {source}->{target} recorded as {resolved_source}->{resolved_target}).
